name: CISO360AI
description: CISO360AI (ciso360.ai) is a security and compliance platform for organisations that don't have a full-time security team. This connector lets Claude read your live CISO360AI data — assets, findings, vulnerabilities, leaked-credential alerts, risks, compliance frameworks and evidence — and help you act on it, with the platform's own approval rules still in charge. Claude can summarise where you stand, explain what a finding means in plain language, draft remediation plans, and propose compliance updates for you to approve in the app.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CISO360AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CISO360AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.ciso360.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CISO360AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CISO360AI lists 38 MCP tools, including bulk_triage_findings, delete_asset, get_assessment, get_asset, get_context, get_coverage, get_cve_detail, get_gaps, get_maturity, get_project_summary, get_requirement, and get_risk_stats.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CISO360AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CISO360AI in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
CISO360AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CISO360AI is developed by Altersec Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
